description: Motion-forge starter presets. Each entry indexes a directory under engine/themes/presets/<id>/ containing preset.json + preview.lottie.json + README.md.

presets.name: Logo Reveal
presets.tagline: 6-second logo lock-up with a brand-color pulse.
presets.brief_skeleton: Reveal {LOGO}. Background pulses to {BRAND_COLOR}. End on logo locked in center.

presets.name: 60-Second Explainer
presets.brief_skeleton: Explain {PRODUCT} in 60 seconds. Beat 1 (0-6s): hook on {PAIN_POINT}. Beat 2 (6-24s): introduce {SOLUTION}. Beat 3 (24-48s): show three concrete benefits. Beat 4 (48-60s): CTA to {NEXT_STEP}.

presets.name: Vertical Social Ad
presets.tagline: 8-second 9:16 ad with a stopping first frame.
presets.brief_skeleton: Open on {HOOK} in the first 0.5s. Show {PRODUCT} in motion. End on {CTA} card with {LOGO} bottom-right.

presets.name: Square Feed Ad
presets.tagline: 15-second square ad sized for the social feed.
presets.brief_skeleton: Square feed ad. 0-3s: bold headline {HOOK}. 3-11s: three feature beats for {PRODUCT}. 11-15s: end card with {CTA}.

presets.name: Lower Thirds
presets.brief_skeleton: Lower-thirds card. Slide in {NAME} on the top bar and {TITLE} on the bottom bar. Hold 3 seconds. Slide out.

presets.name: Loader Spinner
presets.brief_skeleton: Seamless 2s loading spinner in {BRAND_ACCENT}. Smooth, perpetual rotation.

presets.name: Onboarding Sequence
presets.brief_skeleton: 5-screen onboarding for {PRODUCT}. Screen 1 (0-6s): welcome. Screen 2 (6-12s): {FEATURE_1}. Screen 3 (12-18s): {FEATURE_2}. Screen 4 (18-24s): {FEATURE_3}. Screen 5 (24-30s): {CTA}.

presets.name: Kinetic Typography
presets.brief_skeleton: Animate three words for emphasis: {WORD_1}, {WORD_2}, {WORD_3}. Each word lands hard, holds, then transitions.

presets.name: Sticker Pack (.lottie)
presets.tagline: 6 looping 256-px stickers exported as a .lottie pack.
presets.brief_skeleton: 6 sticker concepts for {THEME}. Each sticker loops at 3s, 256x256. Bold, friendly, pack-ready.

presets.name: Product Launch Teaser
presets.brief_skeleton: Tease the launch of {PRODUCT}. 0-6s: countdown 3-2-1. 6-14s: reveal {PRODUCT} with {HEADLINE}. 14-20s: CTA card with {LAUNCH_DATE} and {URL}.
